content.short: Cardano NFT project that features heroes of the blockchains.
content.description: Cardano NFT project that features heroes of the blockchains. It's a tribute to great people of the cryptospace. It's not NFT project only, it has also an educational part. It's purpose is also to introduce people newcomers should know. There is a website with information about the heroes to help newcomers with brief info and links where you can dig deeper. NFT's are not randomly generated, they are all hand-drawn! Some of Heroes have special variations. Variations are not just random gadgets, everything makes some sense.
content.meta: Find out about Crypto Heroez (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
